questions.q: In the Summit Ridge scenario, why do 1,240 Contacts matter for reporting and access?
options: Contacts with no AccountId are private contacts, visible only to their owner
Contacts with no AccountId are automatically deleted after 30 days
Contacts with no AccountId cannot be exported by Data Loader
Contacts with no AccountId are counted twice in every report
questions.explain: A Contact with no Account is a private contact, visible only to its owner, which is why the orphan Contacts are a real business problem.

questions.q: Why did six spellings of 'Trade Show' end up in LeadSource?
options: The picklist isn't restricted, so imports could write any value into it
Salesforce automatically generates spelling variants
LeadSource is a formula field
Data Loader rewrites picklist values on export
questions.explain: Unrestricted picklist fields accept any value written through an import or the API, so nothing stopped the stray spellings.

questions.q: What role does Legacy_Id__c play in this capstone?
options: An External ID that lets an upsert match records without knowing Salesforce IDs
A required system field on every Salesforce object
A formula that calculates record counts
A field that prevents duplicate Leads automatically
questions.explain: Legacy_Id__c is a custom External ID field. Upsert can match on it, so the load doesn't depend on Salesforce record IDs.

questions.q: Why record baseline counts before any cleaning?
options: So the post-load numbers can be compared against a predicted result to prove the change worked
Because Data Loader refuses to run without them
Because SOQL requires a COUNT before any UPDATE
To reset the org's API limits
questions.explain: Baselines are how you validate afterward: the new counts must land where you predicted, or you investigate.

questions.q: In the five-step plan, where does the first real load run?
options: In a sandbox, with production repeated only after a clean sandbox run
Directly in production, since a backup exists
In production during business hours to test load
In whichever org is fastest
questions.explain: Every change is rehearsed in the sandbox first. Production is repeated only after the sandbox run validates cleanly.
